description: Shared contract for GLiNER / NER extraction and Neo4j storage. Only listed entity and relation types may be written to the graph.

entity_types.name: Event
entity_types.description: A ticketed occurrence (concerts, sports, etc.) managed in events-api.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Client or promoter org in admin hierarchy.

entity_types.name: InventoryZone
entity_types.description: Admissions or other zone from inventory-api.

entity_types.name: PriceLevel
entity_types.description: Named price tier within a zone.

entity_types.name: TicketType
entity_types.description: Ticket type configuration on a zone.

entity_types.name: ApiEndpoint
entity_types.description: Documented REST path from OpenAPI / KB chunks.

entity_types.name: DocumentChunk
entity_types.description: Source text span synced from kb.json or operator transcripts.

relation_types.name: HOSTED_AT
relation_types.description: Event is hosted at this client venue.

relation_types.name: HAS_ZONE
relation_types.description: Event has inventory zone (e.g. primary admissions).

relation_types.name: USES_PRICE_CODE
relation_types.description: Zone references price codes on publish snapshot.

relation_types.name: SAME_AS
relation_types.description: Entity resolution merge edge (confidence >= threshold only).
